name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Stormwind, you search the Flintridge belongings for clues to Stalvan Mistmantle. Sealed crates by the canals hold the household’s remaining possessions, while restless spirits tied to the massacre guard what remains.

sections.title: Echoes of a Massacre
sections.body: You trace Stalvan’s path from Duskwood to Stormwind. Beside the city canals, Caretaker Folsom watches over what remains of the Flintridge household. His father served the estate before him and had to mop up blood after a massacre that claimed the household. The name Stalvan is somehow tied to that slaughter.

sections.title: The Auction of a Ruined House
sections.body: The Flintridge trust funds are gone, and royal tax collectors press the estate. Its surviving heirlooms and packed belongings are sealed inside shipping crates along the canal embankment, awaiting auction. You search the boxes for Stalvan’s trail before the family’s remaining goods are scattered to collectors across the kingdom.

sections.title: A Restless Shade
sections.body: A Forlorn Spirit attacks anyone who disturbs the Flintridge crates. The trauma of the murders clings to the family’s salvaged possessions, and the weeping apparition is believed to be the shade of young Tilloa Flintridge. Her spirit remains bound to the relics of the life cut short.

faq.q: Where can I find Caretaker Folsom?
aliases: where is caretaker folsom in stormwind
faq.answer: Caretaker Folsom watches over the Flintridge goods beside the Canals in Stormwind City, near shipping crates stacked by the waterway.

faq.q: What happened to the Flintridge family?
faq.answer: The wealthy Flintridge household was torn apart by a sudden massacre. Caretaker Folsom says his father had to mop up the blood afterward; who was responsible remains unclear.

faq.q: Why are the family's possessions packed in crates along the canal?
aliases: why are crates in the canals
faq.answer: The Flintridge trust funds ran dry after the tragedy. Their remaining belongings were crated and staged beside the canals for auction, under pressure from kingdom tax collectors.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when the crate is opened?
faq.answer: The massacre’s trauma bound the victims’ souls to their former belongings. A Forlorn Spirit attacks to defend the crates, and many believe it is the shade of Tilloa Flintridge, one of the murdered children.

faq.q: How does this connect back to Duskwood?
aliases: why are we in stormwind for a duskwood quest
faq.answer: The investigation began in Darkshire as a search for the missing Stalvan Mistmantle. Tracing his history led to his time as tutor to the Flintridge family in Elwynn and Stormwind.

faq.q: What do you find inside the sealed crate?
faq.answer: The crate holds musty heirlooms among packed furniture and personal effects. Near the bottom, you find a torn page from Stalvan’s journal, the next clue.

angles.text: The Flintridge tragedy unfolds in Stormwind, the kingdom’s capital, and shows how violence can undo even its most sheltered noble lines.
As a priest, you face the weeping Forlorn Spirit in the city canals. Its torment belongs to innocent souls murdered before their time, and it demands peace from the Light.
